name: How can I prevent future drain clogs after rooter service?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future drain clogs after rooter service?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future drain clogs, avoid pouring grease down sinks, use drain screens to catch hair and food particles, and be mindful of what goes into your garbage disposal. Regular flushing of drains with hot water can help, and for homes with recurring issues due to tree roots, annual or bi-annual rooter service can be a proactive measure. Our technicians in the Las Vegas area can also recommend specific maintenance tips based on your home's plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by avoiding grease, using drain screens, and regular maintenance. Consider proactive rooter service for root intrusion issues.
